channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Melatonin use linked to lower REM sleep in children
item.description: A pediatric observational study suggests melatonin use may reduce the percentage of rapid eye movement sleep in children.

item.title: Ebola kills one every 30 minutes in DR Congo: UN
item.description: A UN humanitarian official reported that Ebola is now claiming a life every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

item.title: DC microcurrent stimulation reduces postsurgical scar depth
item.description: A pilot study found that direct-current microcurrent stimulation significantly reduced measured postsurgical scar depth.

item.title: Winter is coming: Vaccines guard against respiratory illness
item.description: August is National Immunization Awareness Month, a good time to prepare for seasonal viruses and bacteria.
